definitions.full: H4822. Meremoth מְרֵמוֺת proper name, masculine 1. priest, time of Zerubbabel Neh 12:3 (= מְרָיוֺת , q. v., 12:15 ) ᵐ5 L Μαρειμωθ . 2 priest, time of Ezra and Nehemiah , Ezra 8:33 ; Neh 3:4 , 21 ; 10:6 (probably same). ᵐ5 Μερειμωθ , Μεραμωθ , etc. 3 one of those who had taken strange wives Ezra 10:36 . ᵐ5 Ιεραμωθ , A Μαρεμωθ . מִרְמַס see רמס .
